name: Guiltless · Pé N' Areia Beach Party
description: Head south of the city for a classic summer beach party with a lineup of DJs spinning techno, tech house, and deep house right on the sand.
longDescription:
Guiltless · Pé N' Areia Beach Party is a nightlife event taking place on August 1, 2026, at Praia de Esmoriz. This beach party is organized by Guiltless, a collective known for curating electronic music events. The event focuses on bringing a lineup of DJs to a coastal setting, offering a specific soundscape of techno, tech house, and deep house music.

Attendees can expect an outdoor party atmosphere directly on the sand, characteristic of a summer beach event. The music will be played by a selection of DJs, creating a continuous flow of electronic genres. The event is designed for an audience interested in electronic music and a relaxed, open-air party environment by the sea.

Ticket information and pricing are available on the event's website. Praia de Esmoriz is located south of Porto. Specific public transport routes from Porto to Esmoriz include regional train services from Campanhã station.
